scope: All 75 already-established person subjects; Scripture and special feast subjects must be read from existing canonical IDs rather than redefined.

targetPolicy.interpretation: Goals where genuinely suitable works exist; never pad with bad attributions/icons/prints/duplicates or low-quality sources
targetPolicy.reproduction: Exact original and high-resolution image, faithful clean painting-only crop, independent custodian verification, rights review, historical and liturgical matching, aesthetic user rating before release
targetPolicy.deduplication: Physical original primary key, never count Wikimedia photographic variants as separate artworks

requiredNextPass: For each seeded Wikipedia article inspect infobox, image captions, media files and linked Commons category (including relevant language editions). Classify works as portrait/saint scene/Scripture/feast, reconcile with all existing art catalogues and human scores, then use museum/Commons rights and fidelity gates. Scan canonical Scripture and feast IDs separately before claiming overall coverage.
